categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: (1) Network advertising and value-added services, including platform advertising promotion, traffic operation, and internet product sales; (2) Game business, encompassing game joint operation, exclusive distribution, and subsidiary Floating Cloud's game development and operation; (3) Exhibition business, centered on ChinaJoy (China International Digital Interactive Entertainment Expo) organized by subsidiary Shanghai Hanwei.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed leading technologies including three-layer updates, ultra-fast streaming, penetration restoration technology, virtual disk technology, intelligent driver loading, intelligent pre-reading, intelligent caching, server IO concurrent processing, and cloud system technology. In the computing power field, the company has independently developed the Shunwang Cloud edge computing platform, distributed GPU computing power management platform, and AI infrastructure platform (Shunwang Smart Computing) supporting multi-modal AI model services and intelligent agent engines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves game manufacturers (95%+ of domestic game publishers), internet service venues (cybercafes, esports hotels, esports bars), enterprise customers requiring computing power and AI solutions, and end consumers through its esports and entertainment platforms. The company covers 96%+ of cities nationwide with core products serving 70%+ of the esports service industry market.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It maintains offices and operations across major Chinese cities. The company also has overseas presence through subsidiaries in Hong Kong, British Virgin Islands, and Singapore, with emerging international expansion in the esports business.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: downstream in the esports service ecosystem (serving end-users and venues), midstream in game distribution and marketing (between game publishers and players), and upstream in computing infrastructure provision (providing edge computing and AI services to various industries).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) advancing edge computing and AI infrastructure development; (2) expanding cloud esports solutions and promoting industry cloud transformation; (3) developing AI-driven marketing intelligence services; (4) innovating in digital human technology, AIGC applications, and intelligent agent systems; (5) globalizing esports business operations; (6) integrating AI across all business scenarios to enhance operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) network advertising and value-added services (72.71% of 2024 revenue) from platform-based advertising and traffic monetization; (2) game business (20.83% of revenue) from game joint operation, exclusive distribution, and self-developed game operations; (3) exhibition services (6.33% of revenue) from ChinaJoy and related events; (4) computing power services from edge computing infrastructure and AI services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading provider in China's esports service ecosystem and digital entertainment platform. It competes with other game distribution platforms, esports venue management software providers, and emerging cloud gaming service providers. The company maintains competitive advantages through extensive market coverage (70%+ of esports venues), strong brand recognition (ChinaJoy), proprietary technology, and integrated service offerings across the esports value chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large sized technology enterprise with 2024 revenue of 1.84 billion yuan, representing 28.37% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached 251.88 million yuan, up 48.60% from 2023. The company maintains strong financial health with total assets of 2.80 billion yuan and net assets of 2.23 billion yuan. Operating cash flow reached 378.74 million yuan in 2024, demonstrating solid cash generation capability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive end-to-end esports ecosystem solutions spanning game publishers, service venues, and consumers; (2) proprietary cloud technology enabling low-latency, high-performance gaming experiences across devices; (3) AI-powered marketing intelligence providing precise user targeting and content distribution; (4) extensive industry network and brand influence through ChinaJoy platform; (5) integrated computing power and AI infrastructure supporting multiple industry applications; (6) focus on industry digitalization and cloud transformation reducing operational costs for partners.
